name: Spirit Guides
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes between the true guidance of the Holy Spirit and the deceptive influence of familiar spirits or wizards, warning believers not to seek or associate with them as they defile and bring judgment (Leviticus 19:31; 20:27). The Holy Spirit, sent by the Father in Jesus' name, is the true Comforter and Spirit of truth who teaches, reminds, and guides believers into all truth (John 14:26; 16:13). Those who are led by the Spirit of God are recognized as God's children and called to present themselves as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to Him (Romans 8:14; 12:1).
